text: Gone without asking. Oh, thank goodness, a captain! I'm Professor Sprocket. My four helper robots, Beep, Boop, Clank and Fizz, have run away on holiday. Without asking!
Where did they go? Beep went sunbathing on a desert planet. Boop is splashing on a water world. Clank is exploring a mine. And Fizz went to see the fireworks, of course.
Handle with care. Each robot needs one hold in your ship. Pick them all up and bring them home. Be gentle with Clank. He gets space sick.
Home sweet home. All four home, safe and sound! Beep has a tan, Boop is dripping, Clank needs a lie down, and Fizz won't stop talking about sparkles.
A present for you. Here's your reward, captain. And Beep made you this. It's a drawing of you. Well, Beep thinks it's you.
